close_reason: Added PartialEq, Eq to MailboxFilterCondition derive list (crate-jmap-mail-types/src/mailbox.rs:229), matching EmailFilterCondition and EmailSubmissionFilterCondition. serde_json::Value implements both traits, so no compile issues. Tests + clippy clean for jmap-mail-types; downstream jmap-mail-server and jmap-mail-client still compile.
description:
All three filter-condition types in this crate are excluded from the extras-preservation policy (correctly — filter algebra exclusion), and they SHOULD have consistent derives across the canonical template:

```
crate-jmap-mail-types/src/query.rs:80
  #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
  pub struct EmailFilterCondition { ... }

crate-jmap-mail-types/src/submission.rs:266
  #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
  pub struct EmailSubmissionFilterCondition { ... }

crate-jmap-mail-types/src/mailbox.rs:229
  #[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
  pub struct MailboxFilterCondition { ... }   // missing PartialEq, Eq
```

`MailboxFilterCondition` is the odd one out. The derive omission likely traces to its `parent_id: Option<serde_json::Value>` field — `serde_json::Value` is `PartialEq` + `Eq` (verified at serde_json 1.0.149 src/value/mod.rs:115), so the derives would compile cleanly.

Cookie-cutter sibling crates (jmap-chat-types, jmap-calendars-types, etc.) will inherit this template inconsistency when they propagate filter conditions. Easier to fix now than to chase divergence later.

Fix: add `PartialEq, Eq` to MailboxFilterCondition's derive list.

Impact: enables `assert_eq!` on MailboxFilterCondition values in test code; matches sibling derive lists; no wire-format change.
title: MailboxFilterCondition missing PartialEq, Eq derives — diverges from sibling filter conditions
